output.description: HS 847130 covers portable automatic data processing machines weighing no more than 10kg that include, at minimum, a central processing unit, a keyboard, and a display - commonly laptop and notebook computers. It falls under HS 8471, the broader heading for automatic data processing machines and related units, within Section XVI (machinery and mechanical appliances; electrical equipment). The defining criteria are portability, weight, and the specific combination of built-in components.
